newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa higher, coffee and sugar head lower AM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa higher, coffee and sugar head lower AM.

text.p: COCOA - Gaps higher at the open and rises further. Sept hits new one-year high at 1,140 stg before retraces a bit. Still three up at 1,131 stg at 0929 GMT.
COFFEE - Off-lows after gapping $55 down at the start. Awaits LIFFE, U.S. stock data. Sept off $25 at $1,760.
SUGAR - Barely traded and prices drift slightly lower. Aug off $1.30 at $323.00
